name: Resource Backpacks
summary: Seven tiers of upgradable backpacks that add extra inventory space. Backpacks can be equipped in an extra slot, opened with a key, placed like shulker boxes, and upgraded by crafting the previous tier with more expensive materials.

new_content.name: Leather Backpack
new_content.how_to_obtain: Craft: 8 leather around a wooden chest; also found in structure chests

new_content.name: Copper Backpack
new_content.how_to_obtain: Leather Backpack surrounded by 8 copper ingots

new_content.name: Iron Backpack
new_content.how_to_obtain: Copper Backpack surrounded by 8 iron ingots

new_content.name: Gold Backpack
new_content.how_to_obtain: Iron Backpack with 6 gold ingots and 2 shulker shells (top and bottom centre)

new_content.name: Diamond Backpack
new_content.how_to_obtain: Gold Backpack with 4 shulker shells and 4 diamonds

new_content.name: Netherite Backpack
new_content.how_to_obtain: Diamond Backpack with 4 netherite ingots, 2 diamonds and 2 shulker boxes

new_content.name: End Backpack
new_content.how_to_obtain: Gold Backpack with 4 diamonds, 2 eyes of ender and an ender chest; gives access to your Ender Chest

mechanics.title: Equip and open
mechanics.description: A dedicated slot holds an equipped backpack; press B to open it. Optionally right-click to open from the inventory (config).

mechanics.title: Placing
mechanics.description: Backpacks can be placed as blocks and used like shulker boxes, and put on armor stands.

mechanics.title: Preview
mechanics.description: Hold Left-Shift for a compact summed item list or Left-Alt for the full inventory layout in the tooltip.

mechanics.title: Mob spawns and loot
mechanics.description: Zombies and creepers can spawn with leather or copper backpacks. Backpacks appear in structure chests (villages, strongholds, mansions, shipwrecks, mineshafts and others) and trial chamber rewards, by tier.

mechanics.title: Backpacks in backpacks
mechanics.description: A config option allows storing backpacks inside backpacks (effectively infinite storage); its default is not confirmed.

getting_started: Craft a Leather Backpack from leather and a chest, equip it, then upgrade through the tiers.
editor_notes: Slot counts per tier are configurable and not in the facts. Upgrade recipes are shaped with the previous backpack in the centre.
